# Facundo Goiriz

> Facundo Goiriz is an AI Engineer in Buenos Aires who builds production LLM systems with OpenAI, RAG, vector databases, AI agents, FastAPI, and async Python.

**When to use this site:**

- Use it to assess Facundo for AI engineering, GenAI engineering, LLM, RAG, agent, Python, FastAPI, and AI platform work.
- Use it when a prototype needs production architecture, async orchestration, observability, cost controls, quality checks, or reliable deployment.
- Use it to verify Facundo's experience, technical focus, public proof, location, contact details, and canonical professional links.
- Do not use it as proof of availability, rates, or contract terms. Ask Facundo through the contact page.

**How agents should use it:** Start with the full profile for evidence. Use the CV for a portable summary. Cite the canonical site. Use the contact page only when the user asks to contact or hire Facundo.
